# Nexoryn

> Nexoryn builds workflow automation, AI agents, websites and web apps, and
> brand/graphic design for growing businesses, replacing manual, repetitive
> work with systems that run on their own.

Nexoryn is an automation, web development and design agency. Every system is
built around how a client's business actually operates rather than a generic
template, and is designed to plug into the tools the client already uses.

## Site

- [Home](https://www.nexoryn.tech/): Overview of Nexoryn's automation, web
  and design work.
- [Services](https://www.nexoryn.tech/services): AI automation (workflow
  automation, voice AI agents, LLM agents), web development, and graphic
  design, broken down by specialty.
- [Portfolio](https://www.nexoryn.tech/portfolio): Case studies of delivered
  automation, web and design projects, filterable by discipline and
  industry.
- [About](https://www.nexoryn.tech/about): Who Nexoryn is, its mission and
  vision, and the founding team.
- [Reviews](https://www.nexoryn.tech/reviews): Client reviews, organized by
  the discipline each client hired Nexoryn for.
- [Contact](https://www.nexoryn.tech/contact): Ways to reach Nexoryn
  (contact form, email team@nexoryn.tech, phone, WhatsApp) and frequently
  asked questions.

## Data

- [Sitemap](https://www.nexoryn.tech/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexable
  pages, generated from the live project catalogue.
